# Auto-review starter rules

Proposed rules for Grok Bot Auto-review, generated from `agent-policies` 0.2.0. These are a proposal: the user adds them in the app; nothing here is applied automatically.

## deny-env-dump

- Rule: Block shell commands that print the environment or secret files.
- Action: deny

## deny-remote-writes

- Rule: Ask before pushing, adding remotes, skipping hooks or changing GitHub state.
- Action: ask

## deny-workspace-wipe

- Rule: Block recursive deletes of /workspace roots.
- Action: deny

## OWN-1

- Rule: Write only your own paths. A bot writes only under paths it owns per the layout and `etc/registry.json`. Everything else is read-only to it.
- Action: ask

## SEC-1

- Rule: No secrets on disk or in git. Never write secrets, tokens or environment values to `/workspace`, logs, memory or any repo. Never print environment variables.
- Action: ask

## GIT-1

- Rule: No remote side effects without approval. No push, force-push, remote creation, history rewrite or hook bypass without explicit user approval.
- Action: ask
